scripts.build: bun run brand:assets && astro build && node scripts/build-headers.mjs && node scripts/build-bot-page.mjs
scripts.deploy:staging: SITE_URL=https://preview.freeclaws.ai PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://app.freeclaws.ai bun run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: SITE_URL=https://clawbits.ai PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://app.clawbits.ai bun run build && wrangler deploy --env production
